target.title: fix(qqbot): require own account credential entries
target.body:
### What Problem This Solves

QQBot credential clearing accepted inherited named-account entries and inherited credential fields because it used prototype-aware property checks. That could make logout/setup cleanup report changes for config the user did not actually define on the account entry.

### Why This Change Was Made

Use own-property checks for the account map, credential fields, and default-account credential fields. This keeps credential clearing scoped to real config entries and also removes own empty credential fields consistently.

### User Impact

QQBot credential cleanup now ignores prototype-inherited account data and clears only own `clientSecret` / `clientSecretFile` fields. Normal own account cleanup still drops empty named account entries after credentials are removed.

### Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/engine/config/credentials.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/qqbot/src/engine/config/credentials.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/config/credentials.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --threads=1 extensions/qqbot/src/engine/config/credentials.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/config/credentials.test.ts`
- `env -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u OPENAI_ORG_ID -u OPENAI_PROJECT_ID .agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` (exit 0, no findings)
